name: hook
text: Nyari co-founder di Web3 itu kayak berburu di rawa. DM spam, LinkedIn CV mengkilap, tapi gak ada bukti.

name: insight
text: Cuma ada satu hal yang gak bisa di-fake: jejak onchain. Kalau lu shipping, wallet lu tau.

name: demo-profile
text: BuilderMatch connect wallet — lima detik, AI bikin profile dari on-chain activity. Skill verified. Contributions verified. Gak bisa boong.

name: demo-swipe
text: Swipe feed sesama builder. AI score compatibility: skill complement, value align, timezone fit. Bukan chemistry feeling — math.

name: demo-match
text: Mutual match, buka chat, kolaborasi tiga puluh hari — selesai, mint NFT collaboration. Reputasi lu jadi portable. Next project, matches tau lu real.

name: vision
text: Lima ratus ribu builder di Web3. Semua nyari partner. BuilderMatch — work with proof.
